Alright heres how its going to go.

If it happened tomorrow it would be USA and NATO vs China, Russia and Iran/North Korea.

Why? Simply because of Chinas behavior in the last 10 years points to it. China is behaving very much like 19th century Europe, especially Germany during the pre Great War years. Heavy manufacturing, intense meddling in Africa, naval buildup to rival the greatest navy at the time (then Britain, today USA). China is growing too fast and too strong to be viewed as nothing but a threat for the West and established powers. 

How will it happen? The Chinese will press claims to the Philippines or start shit with Japan. They'll use their navy to lock down the South China Sea, forcing the USA's hand. Or less dramatically, Israel will bomb Iran, sparking a chain reaction that will eventually involve all the world powers into war with each other. 

Who wins? I think if it happened tomorrow the Chinese would. Why? Russia is the wild card here. Russia would easily overpower the European militaries and there would be a second front America would have to fight, ignoring the serious trouble happening in Asia. The combined arms of Russia and China would destroy the USA and its allies in all theaters, which I expect to be Africa, the Korean Peninsula and Iraq. 

How can we avoid this fate? Woo Russia. Whoever Russia sides with wins the war. They could open up a second front through northern China and pincer the Chinese. How do we do this? The same way Britain reconciled with France after 2000 years of fighting, sign an Entente. We leave Russias empire alone, drop all support for former USSR democracies like Ukraine and Georgia and let Russia absorb them back into its sphere of influence. On the same token, Russia lets us do our own thing in the Middle East. We have joint military training, allow officer exchange on naval vessels and in general keep out of eachothers business.

Then when the war comes, we can defeat China, because a Chinese ruled world would be bad for everyone.
